9. Advance Local previously outsourced the scheme to Catena Media, which says it attracts players to gambling sites by “leveraging the visibility we gain from… high rankings on popular search engines.”

8. The tactic is actually an SEO play that leverages the search ranking these news sites have earned by producing actual reporting. When people use the codes to sign up for a sports book or other gambling activity, Advance Local earns a fee or a percentage of their loses.

4. Special Correspondent Christopher Feery then detailed the five steps required to “claim the Kalshi promo code and land a bonus in a flash.” Feery published a nearly identical articles about UFC 328 for The Star-Ledger and The Birmingham News, two other Pulitzer Prize-winning publications.

3. The piece noted that UFC 328 was “an awesome opportunity for new users to grab the Kalshi promo code PENNLIVE and get a $10 bonus when they trade $10+.” Special Correspondent Christopher Feery then detailed the five steps required to “claim the Kalshi promo code and land a bonus in a flash.”
